notes.notes:
Change log

 Fixed the video library download issue except China district.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.25
notes.notes:
Change log

 Don't show UI when auto startup.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.24
notes.notes:
Change log

 HD/4K quality option in video filter panel.
 Can view and download 4K wallpaper when 4K option is selected.
 Preview of video library wallpaper.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.22
notes.notes:
Change log

 Remove a file in recent tab will remove the library or workshop item, including the local file.
 Workshop cancel download function.
 Show file size on the preview panel.
 Use stretch style for image wallpaper by default.
 Show download speed. 
 Fixed the issue that Windows 7 shows player icon on taskbar.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.17
notes.notes:
Change log

 Clicking refresh button in workshop will restore search, sorting, filters after refreshing.
 Removed auto refresh behind upload, since it usually takes 7-10 minutes to show an uploaded new item in workshop.
 Show the progress ring right away after clicking on set wallpaper button for a workshop item.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.15
notes.notes:
Change log

 The beautification of the inactive window style. Keep the original style of the title bar and use a better border style, when the window is inactive.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.14 - workshop fix
notes.notes:
We've fixed the workshop. You can use the workshop now. We will upgrade another patch later today for the remaining issues including refresh of workshop list in the current selected order, download speed enhancement, showing a progress indicator right away when click on set wallpaper button.

Change log

 Can upload the complete file.
 No failure for upload any more.
 Won't fail when upload a big file.
 No issue to download wallpapers.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.10
notes.notes:
Change log

 Add Collection type and dozens of new categories under it.
 Fixed the occasional issue of setting the preview image as wallpaper when workshop video has already been downloaded.
 Can show apps in app&game tab even if the user does not have privilege to read registry.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Change log

 Fixed the app can't start issue.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Change log

 Add global exception handler to catch the start exception and write the error message to the log file.
 Show error message for not handled global exception.
 Solved the issue of occasional no loading icon in library and workshop tab.
 Fixed the issue that the paging shows previous value like page 1/5 when the search or filter doesn't return results.
 Fixed the issue possibly caused by dependencies between video library and steam workshop.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Change log

 Add track information for launch in the log file.

notes.title: Patch upgrade
notes.notes:
Change log

 Click on the title of workshop wallpaper on the right panel to visit the workshop web page.
 Fix the auto startup error.

notes.title: Patch upgrade
notes.notes:
Change log

 Add Cancel Download button
 Multiple downloads simultaneously
 Show message for download error

notes.title: Patch upgrade
notes.notes:
We've been fixing bugs in the past two weeks. The latest patch upgrade has fixed most of the issues mentioned by the curators.

Change log

 Launch time optimization.
 Run without having to launch Steam.
 Smooth run when switch the wallpaper.
 Change preview image for selected wallpaper.
 Fast load the wallpaper list on start.
 Show progress spinner when loading wallpaper list.
 Left mouse click on tray to call out menu
 Left mouse double click on tray to call out the main program.
 Localization of the video library.
 Keep the user's original wallpaper.
 No black screen wallpaper any more.
